risk_if_not_implemented: Without Unmeasurable AI & Autonomous Technologies Risks, AI and autonomous systems may produce unreliable, biased or unsafe outputs, act outside authorized scope, or expose sensitive data. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unaddressed Security / Compliance Exposure (R-GV-2), Inability to Demonstrate Due Diligence / Due Care (R-GV-9), Unreliable Assurance / Decision Information (R-GV-10), and most likely increases susceptibility to Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Continuous Monitoring
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of enterprise-wide monitoring controls.
compensating_control_1.justification: Continuous Monitoring (MON-02) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Unmeasurable AI & Autonomous Technologies Risks (AAT-36.3) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Incident Response Plan (IRP)
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to maintain and make available a current and viable Incident Response Plan (IRP) to all stakeholders.
compensating_control_2.justification: Incident Response Plan (IRP) (IRO-08) provides incident response capability that compensates for the absence of Unmeasurable AI & Autonomous Technologies Risks (AAT-36.3) by enabling timely detection, containment, and recovery from security events in the absence of the primary control. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
